name: search_open_pos
description: Search purchase orders by supplier, date range, and value threshold. Returns composed PO objects with line items, supplier scorecard summary, contract reference, and any active rebate tier in one response.
intent_examples: show me open POs for supplier X
which purchase orders haven't shipped this quarter
find POs over $50k that are past due
what are we waiting on from Eaton

supplier_id.description: Normalized supplier identifier from the CDM. Omit to search across all suppliers.

value_threshold.description: Minimum PO total value (in tenant base currency).

customer_id.description: Restrict to POs associated with a specific customer.

returns.description: Composed PurchaseOrder envelope. Includes header, line items, supplier scorecard summary, contract reference, and active rebate tier.

failure_modes: Backend IDoc queue saturation may cause >5s latency on high-volume tenants
Returns cached data with staleness flag during scheduled batch windows
Returns partial result with degraded scorecard if supplier risk service is open-circuit
